name: PancakeHunny HunnyMinter mintFor reward inflation
summary: HunnyMinter.mintFor() sized the HUNNY reward from IBEP20(flip).balanceOf(address(this)) instead of the performance-fee amount actually transferred in, so a flash-loaned CakeFlipVault deposit minted an inflated HUNNY reward.

assets.description: 3.39 WBNB in this transaction; the exploit contract was run 91 times (PancakeHunny incident report)

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: HunnyMinter 0x109Ea28dbDea5E6ec126FbC8c33845DFe812a300 created 2021-06-01T03:31:00Z by 0xe5f7e3dd9a5612eccb228392f47b7ddba8ce4f1a, unrelated to attack sender 0x0ef50be29c82ecf2158ec1886dc6692a2b0db411; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events before the incident, age measured from deployment.
